# Grays Universal Industries LLC

> Web design, apps, and digital services based in Traverse City, Michigan.

## About
Grays Universal Industries LLC builds websites, web apps, software, branding, social media content, and hosting for businesses in Michigan and across the United States.

## Location
Traverse City, Michigan, United States

- Server Hosting
